claims.text: E-Flora BC treats the native coastal yarrow as Achillea borealis var. borealis (synonym A. millefolium var. borealis): origin Native, provincial list Yellow, rank S5 (secure). The A. millefolium species page itself carries origin status Exotic (SNA), while its taxonomic note recognises four native ecogeographic varieties (alpicola, lanulosa, borealis, pacifica).
claims.context: BC; E-Flora BC atlas — native yarrow genotypes keyed under Achillea borealis var. borealis; the A. millefolium species page is rated Exotic
claims.recorded_by: claude (T5 assisted extraction, structured values only)
claims.note: native and introduced genotypes both occur in BC and E-Flora splits them by name: A. millefolium (species page) = Exotic / SNA; A. borealis var. borealis = Native / S5 / Yellow. The var. pacifica page is also marked Exotic / SNA. Confidence lowered from 0.9 because the native status is attached to a different accepted name
claims.citation: In Klinkenberg, Brian. (Editor) 2020. E-Flora BC: Electronic Atlas of the Plants of British Columbia [eflora.bc.ca]. Lab for Advanced Spatial Analysis, Department of Geography, University of British Columbia, Vancouver. [Accessed: 2026-11-02]
